requirement.clarified: Migrate CodexBashView so all three Codex operation branches (read, write, bash/unknown) render through the shared BashView/CommandView primitives used by the Claude Code flavor. The result must be visually and behaviourally identical to the Claude Code popup modulo Codex-specific labels and icons, and must inherit the horizontal-scroll / overflow handling from §5.3.
requirement.what: Replace divergent CodexBashView read/write/bash rendering with shared BashView + CommandView primitives
requirement.why: The Codex popup diverged from Claude Code at creation (Sep 2025) and was never updated when Claude Code adopted the compact-inline + sidebar-verbose pattern (Mar 2026). Users see a visually inconsistent, overflow-prone popup for Codex commands.

root_cause_analysis.root_cause: CodexBashView.tsx was created in commit cdbcb9ab (Sep 2025) before CommandView and the compact-inline pattern existed. Commit 1c85cc62 (Mar 2026) normalized Claude Code bash rendering but did not update CodexBashView, leaving it on a stale visual path.

root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Read/write branches have no horizontal-scroll protection; bash branch wraps CommandView without ScrollView; container styling diverges from CommandView's terminal theme

development_approach.strategy: Rewrite CodexBashView to delegate all three branches to the same structural primitives as BashView/SidebarBashView. Read/write branches: ScrollView horizontal + icon + label text (no CommandView needed — file operations don't have terminal output). Bash/unknown branch: add ScrollView horizontal wrapper around CommandView, add result parsing (mirror SidebarBashView logic). Remove readContainer stylesheet.
development_approach.validation_approach: yarn typecheck; then QA opens a live Codex session in browser, triggers exec_command + read + write tool calls, verifies: (1) no horizontal overflow in inline card, (2) visual parity with Claude Code bash card, (3) sidebar still works (SidebarBashView regression check), (4) mobile viewport 390x844 also passes

research_findings.reason: Straightforward structural migration — target pattern already exists in BashView.tsx and SidebarBashView.tsx within the same codebase; no external best-practice research required
